name: Unlearn Sticker
summary: Forget a learned sticker so it stops being suggested or sent.
description: Forgets a previously learned sticker. Call it when the user asks to remove, forget, or stop using a sticker rule, or says a learned sticker no longer fits. Uses the id from the "Learned Stickers" list.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the learned sticker to forget, from the "Learned Stickers" list.
